name: PackageTemplate
stmt:
structure PackageTemplate where
  name : String
  paramCount : Nat
  group : String
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

name: UnconstructibleProblem
doc: Bu ke gou zao wen ti.
stmt:
structure UnconstructibleProblem where
  name : String
  reducesTo : String
  dependencies : List String
  externalRef : String
  greenVerified : Bool
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr, Inhabited

name: AxiomPackageInstance
stmt:
structure AxiomPackageInstance where
  name : String
  version : String
  templates : List PackageTemplate
  unconstructibles : List UnconstructibleProblem
  deriving Repr

name: templateNames
stmt: def templateNames (ts : List PackageTemplate) : List String

name: mkTemplates
doc: You luo ming biao gou zao mu ban biao.
stmt: def mkTemplates (ns : List String) (p : Nat) (g : String) : List PackageTemplate
proof: ns.map (fun n => { name := n, paramCount := p, group := g })

name: TemplateNameAvailable
doc: Mu ban ming shi fou ke yong.
stmt: def TemplateNameAvailable (templates : List PackageTemplate) (name : String) : Prop

name: DependenciesSatisfied
doc: Dan ge bu ke gou zao wen ti de yi lai shi fou bei mu ban biao manzu.
stmt: def DependenciesSatisfied (templates : List PackageTemplate) (u : UnconstructibleProblem) : Prop

name: PackageDependenciesValid
proof:
∀ u ∈ pkg.unconstructibles, DependenciesSatisfied pkg.templates u



end Lattice.Lv00.AxiomDischarge
